WebGPU rendering straight into SkiaSharp surfaces. Give it an SKSurface, an SKCanvas, a GRContext or nothing at all and it picks the fastest way to get WebGPU pixels onto it - zero copy when the surface lives on the same GPU device (Vulkan, Direct3D 12 or Metal), one GPU-side draw when it lives on…

A friendly graphics layer over WebGPU for .NET: one context object owning (or sharing) the GPU device, typed buffers, textures, samplers, bind groups and WGSL shaders with readable compile errors, render and compute pipeline builders with vertex layouts derived from your structs, a batched 2D sprit…
